Additionally, while the agent likely sought the cheapest alternative via a product lookup, there is no explicit confirmation of the chosen item with the user before committing the change. Therefore, despite partial compliance (authentication and acting on the correct order), the absence of pre-write confirmation violates the stated policy, leading to a fail verdict.
